name: Bogart
source:
Occupation: Dancer.

Skills/Abilities: He knows how to move his body quickly and flexibly.

Notes: Romantic, seductive, and intelligent. The kind of man who can teach me how to deal with love. He also likes to flirt and hear compliments.

His only downside is that he has a lot of fans running around him. I need to be careful not to call attention to or kill him in this experiment.
